spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (गुणयति)
1 To invite.
2 To advise.
3 To multiply.

m. (-णः)
1 A quality, attribute, or property in general.
2 A property of all created things; three are particularized, the Sattva, Raja, and Tama, or principles of truth or existence, passion or foulness, and darkness or ignorance.
3 A means of defence, one of six expedients in government, as, peace, war, a march, a halt, a stratagem, and recourse to protection: see सन्धि, &c.
4 Form, shape, &c. or property of the body.
5 Knowledge, ignorance, &c. or quality of the mind.
6 Heroism, valor, &c.
7 White, black, &c. or the attributes of color.
8 An organ of sense.
9 A string in general.
10 A bow-string.
11 Abandoning, leaving.
12 A cook.
13 A name of BHĪ

MA.
14

Secondary, subordinate.
15 Excellence, merit, freedom from fault or blemish.
16 (In arithmetic,) The given coefficient of any number.
17 (In geometry,) The chord of an are.
18 (In grammar,) The substitution of e, o, ar and al for i, u, ṛ, ḷ.
19 (In rhetoric,) Consistency of plan, elegance of expression, &c. as the merits of a composition.
20 In composition with numerals, multiplication, as द्विगुण twice, त्रिगुण thrice.
f. (-णा)
A plant of the fibres of which bow-strings are made: see मूर्व्वा.
E.
गुण to address or advise, affix क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 A numerator, a reckoner.
2 (In arithmetic,) The multiplier.
E.
गुण to count, क्वुन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Who counts, &c.
m. (-रः)
A name of BHĪMASENA.
E.
गुण, and कार who makes; BHĪMA performed the duties of a cook at the time all the Pāṇḍava princes became servants to VIRĀṬA.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Possessing all excellences.
m. (-रः)
A name of BUDDHA the founder of the Bauddha sect.
E.
गुण attribute, especially good, and आकर a mine; a mine of merit.

n. (-नं)
Panegyric, praise.
E.
गुण, and गान singing.

n. (-णं)
Acknowledging or appreciating merit.
E.
गुण, and ग्रहण taking.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Who judges or appreciates good qualities.
E.
गुण, and ग्राहिन् who seizes.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
1 Suited to good qualities.
2 Admiring or attached to merit.
E.
गुण, and गृह्य to be caught by.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
A detractor, a calumniator, envious, censorious.
E.
गुण, and घातिन् who destroys.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
One who knows how to appreciate men or things, knowing or judging of their merits.
E.
गुण, and ज्ञ who knows.

ind.
1 According to property or quality.
2 According to desert.
E.
गुण, and तसि aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Excellence, the possession of good qualities.
2 Substantiality, possession of attributes or qualities in general.
3 Multiplication.
E.
गुण, and तल् affix; also with त्व, affix गुणत्वं.

n. (-यं)
The three properties of nature; purity, passion, and darkness.
E.
गुण, and त्रय triple; also गुणत्रितयं.

n. (-णं)
Test or investigation of merits and faults.
E.
गुण, दोष fault, परीक्षण trying.

m. (-र्म्मः)
The virtue incident to the possession of certain qualities, as clemency is the virtue of royalty, &c.
E.
गुण a property, and धर्म्म virtue.

n. (-नं)
1 Describing, relating qualities.
2

Enumerating.
3

Multiplication.
E.
गुण to number, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-का)
1 Dance, the science or profession of dancing, acting, &c.
2 Determining the reading of a manuscript, &c.
3 A cypher.
4 The prologue or introduction to a drama.
5 A necklace.
E.
कन् added to गुणनी.

f. (-नी)
Examining books, studying, collating, and correcting copies, &c.
E.
गुण to advise, affix ल्युट्, and ङीप्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be advised.
2 To be multiplied.
3 To be enumerated.
m. (-यः)
Practice, practising any thing, but especially science or study.
m. (-यं)
The multiplicand.
E.
गुण to advise, &c. अनीवर् aff.

n. (-गं)
Great merit.
E.
गुण, and पूग a heap.

m. (-र्षः)
Great merit, excellence.
E.
गुण, and प्रकर्ष eminence.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Attached to merit, fond of excellence.
E.
गण, and प्रिय fond of.

mfn. (-शः)
The loss of all good qualities.
E.
गुण good property, and भ्रंश fall, loss.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Endowed with or consisting of properties.
2 Possessed of merit.
E.
गुण, and मयट् aff.

n. (-हत्)
Great merit, superior qualities.
E.
गुण, and महत् great.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Having virtues or properties.
E.
गुण, and युक्त joined.

n. (-णं)
Mark or indication of internal property.
E.
गुण, and लक्षण mark.

f. (-का)
A tent.
E.
गुण rope, ली to bind, ल्युट् and ङीप् affix, with कन् added; also गुणलयनी.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Desirous of merit, attached to excellence.
E.
गुण, and लुब्ध covetous.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Possessing attributes.
2 Endowed with good qualities.
3 Tied, bound, &c.
E.
गुण quality, and मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Excellent.
E.
गुणवत् and तमप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Excellent.
E.
गुणवत् and तरप् aff.

f. (-त्ता)
Excellence.
E.
गुणवत् and तल् affix; also with त्व, गुणवत्त्वं.

n. (-कं)
An adjective or attributive noun.
E.
गुण, and वाचक a word.

n. (-ष्यं)
Preeminence of merit or of any property.
E.
गुण, and वैशेष्य superiority.

m. (-कः)
A mast.
E.
गुण a rope, and वृक्ष a tree, कन् affix of similitude; also गुणवृक्षः.

f. (-घा)
Praise, encomium.
E.
गुण, and श्लाघा praise.

f. (-पत् or पद्)
Great merit.
E.
गुण, and सम्पद् wealth.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Association with properties or qualities.
E.
गुण, and सङ्ग combination.

m. (-हः)
A collection of merits or properties.
E.
गुण, and सङ्ग्रह collection.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Endowed with all good qualities.
m. (-रः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

A form of BUDDHA, a Buddha.
E.
गुण excellence, and सागर the ocean; an ocean of desert.

f. (-तिः)
Panegyric, encomium.
E.
गुण, and स्तुति praise.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Void of merit.
2 Free from properties.
E.
गुण, and हीन void of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Freed from or beyond all properties.
E.
गुण, and अतीत passed.

m. (-धः)
Conformity or suitableness to good qualities, &c.
E.
गुण, and अनुरोध concurrence.

n. (-रं)
1 Species or sort of merit.
2 Variety of property or quality.
E.
गुण, and अन्तर difference.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Having attributes or qualities.
2 Excellent, good, endowed with virtues.
E.
गुण, and अन्वित possessed of.

m. (-दः)
Detraction.
E.
गुण, and अपवाद reproach.

m. (-सः)
Semblance of qualities.
E.
गुण, and आभास appearance.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Virtuous, excellent, able, endowed with good qualities.
E.
गुण, and आश्रय asylum.

m. (-णं)
A number of virtuous persons.
E.
गुणिन्, and गण a troop.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Multiplied, (arithmetically.)
2 Collected, heaped together.
E.
गुण to advise, &c. affix क्त.

n. (-धः)
Equality of merit on two sides.
E.
गुणिन्, and द्वैध duality.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
Endowed with good qualities.
m. (-णी)
A bow.
E.
गुण a quality, &c. and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Made secondary or subordinate.
2 Invested with attributes, &c.
3 Varied according to its qualities.
4 Having a certain force or application, (a word, &c.)
E.
गुण, and भृत become, with च्चि augment.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Having good qualities, &c.
m. (-रः)
The name of a mountain, according to some, Citrakūṭa or Comptah in Bundelcund.
E.
गुण qualities, and ईश्वर master or possessor.

m. (-र्षः)
Excellence, endowment with superior qualities.
E.
गुण, and उत्कर्ष abundance.

n. (-नं)
Panegyric, eulogium.
E.
गुण, and उत्कीर्त्तन celebrating.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Superior in merit or in good qualities.
E.
गुण, and उत्कृष्ट best.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Endowed with good qualities.
E.
गुण, and उपेत possessed of.

n. (-घं)
Superior or abundant merit.
E.
गुण, and ओघ heap.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pounded, ground, reduced to dust or powder.
2 Covered with, surrounded.
E.
गुठि to surround, &c. affix क्त; also गुण्डित.

m. (-ण्डः)
A fragrant grass, (Scirpus kysoor.)

m. (-कः)
1 Dust, powder.
2 Dirty meal.
3 An oil vessel.
4 A low tone.
E.
गुडि to surround, &c. affix वुन्.

mf. (-कः-का)
Flour, powder, meal.
E.
गुडि to pound, वुन् affix, and इ inserted.

f. (-चा)
The name of the place where the car of JAGANNĀTHA stays for a week at the Ratha Yātrā.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pounded, ground.
2 Covered with dust.
E.
गुड to grind or pound, affix क्त.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
1 To be enumerated.
2 To be described as qualities, to be praised.
3 To be multiplied, the multiplicand.
E.
गुण to count, क्यप् aff.
